pages.text: $(italic)Dragon-blooded and ancient. Resilient and imposing, the Ryu shrugs off damage and heals from food.$()$(br2)$(bold)Natural Protection$() — $(item)25% damage reduction$(). Extremely durable.$(br2)$(bold)Slow Fall$() — Broken wings grant slow fall, not true flight.$(br2)$(bold)Food Healing$() — Eating food triggers accelerated healing.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Meat Preference$() — $(warn)Non-meat food provides less nourishment.$()$(br2)$(bold)Healing Potions$() — $(warn)Only 50% effective.$() Your scaled hide resists potions.$(br2)$(bold)Next: stock cooked meat, not potions — your healing runs through your stomach.$()
